# Using existing venmo access_token and phone contact details from prior steps
brandon_email = 'brandon-webe@gmail.com'

# Fetch all approved sent payment requests (paginate)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
approved_requests = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # response may be list
    results = page.get('success') if isinstance(page, dict) and 'success' in page else page
    print('page_index', page_index, 'num_results', 0 if results is None else len(results))
    if not results:
        break
    approved_requests.extend(results)
    if len(results) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_approved_sent_payment_requests', len(approved_requests))

# Filter to those sent to Brandon
candidates = [pr for pr in approved_requests if pr.get('receiver', {}).get('email','').lower() == brandon_email.lower()]
print('candidates_by_email', len(candidates))
# If none, broaden by name contains Brandon
if not candidates:
    candidates = [pr for pr in approved_requests if 'brandon' in pr.get('receiver', {}).get('name','').lower()]
    print('candidates_by_name', len(candidates))

# Show candidates
for pr in sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at',''), reverse=True)[:10]:
    print('payment_request_id', pr.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount', pr.get('amount'), 'created_at', pr.get('created_at'), 'receiver', pr.get('receiver'))

# pick latest by created_at
if not candidates:
    raise Exception('No approved sent payment requests found for Brandon')

latest = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at',''))
print('LATEST_payment_request_id', latest.get('payment_request_id'))
print('LATEST_amount', latest.get('amount'))
print('LATEST_created_at', latest.get('created_at'))
print('LATEST_receiver', latest.get('receiver'))
